title: The exact derived adjunction counit on a single complex
statement: Let A,B be abelian categories with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and K-injective resolutions. Let T:A→B and H:B→A be additive exact functors with adjunction a:T⊣H. Let h:RH(L[0])≅(HL)[0] be the canonical exact-H single comparison and t:D(T)((HL)[0])≅(THL)[0] the exact-T single comparison. For every L in B, D(T)(h⁻¹) followed by the counit of the canonical derived adjunction [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived] at L[0] equals t.hom followed by the single of the underived counit at L.

proof.text: The local hunit lemma uses rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac and cancellation of its isomorphism to express the inverse single right-derived comparison as the inverse exact single comparison, the localization comparison, and the right-derived unit. Apply derivedε_fac_app at the homotopy quotient of the single complex and substitute this equality.

The local hterm lemma replaces the homotopy counit by mapHomotopyCategory_counit_app_quotient. Expand mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app, cancel the quotient comparison inverses, and use quotientCompQhIso_inv_naturality. Move the inverse exact single comparison through the exact functor using mapDerivedCategoryFactors_hom_naturality_assoc. Cancel the remaining exact localization comparison. The resulting equality is the image under Q of an equality of complex morphisms: at degree zero it is counit naturality and the single identification formulas, and away from zero the comparison components vanish. Combine this with the derived counit factorization.

theorem exact_derivedAdjunction_single_counit {T : A ⥤ B} {H : B ⥤ A}
    [T.Additive] [H.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    (adj : T ⊣ H) (L : B) :
    T.mapDerivedCategory.map (H.singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorIso.inv.app L) ≫
      adj.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction.counit.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).obj L) =
    (T.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app (H.obj L) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).map (adj.counit.app L)
